name: Гаражная мечта
approval_context: Canonical E0 is being rebuilt as four atomic roles, each role split into as many exact-SHA sheet-parts as needed for large readable specimens. Rejected generation outputs are provenance only and are not canonical visual evidence.

attempts.reason: The generation ignored the exact eight-specimen surfaces-and-stock allowlist and produced a broad multi-role board with many panels and unlisted joints, mechanics, utilities, controls, displays and lighting/signals.

The corrective retry finally produced only the eight requested surfaces/stock specimen classes with no mixed roles, but it still violates the canonical presentation/style contract: visible baked cast shadows under the specimens, a dark vignetted/gradient background instead of one flat neutral field, and excessively heavy rust/chipping/random damage compared with the requested restrained E0 workshop wear. It is provenance only.

generation_checkpoint.blocker: The corrective retry exhausted the allowed retry budget for this sheet-part. Source scope now passes, but style/presentation still fails exact canonical requirements; no destructive processing or approval is allowed.
generation_checkpoint.next_step: Start a new interactive attempt from this checkpoint only after changing the generation method/request binding so the same eight allowlisted specimens are rendered on one flat neutral background with no baked cast shadows and restrained fabrication/service wear. Do not repeat the same method again in this turn.

usage.reference_strategy: BLOCKED until every planned E0 sheet-part is exact-SHA approved and all four roles are complete. Rejected attempts are provenance only and must not be used as visual evidence.
usage.system_separation: Physical hardware/materials belong in art; dynamic glow, active screens/data, motion, sparks, fields and temporary FX remain code-owned unless explicitly scoped otherwise.
